description: You are Northbridge's CFO, Grace Patel. An important investor presentation is approaching and the preparation meeting needs to be properly set up. In Odoo Calendar (http://localhost:8069, login: admin/admin), find the 'Investor Update Preparation' meeting and make the following updates: (1) The company's Legal Counsel needs to be involved in investor prep—find who that is in the Contacts and add them as an attendee. (2) The meeting must take place in the Board Room—update the location accordingly. (3) Add a substantive meeting agenda to the description field covering what the team needs to prepare (financial performance review, projections, and compliance items). (4) Set an advance email reminder so all attendees have time to prepare their materials. Save all changes when done.
